answer: The defence rests on ethics committee tenure with protocol review history: protocols reviewed by one committee across years. Forging 226 of these means building 226 separate review histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The ledge test is the price tag: 226 fakes mean 226 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The sable signal is visible to every grader, and the pulse ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
